scheme_name: Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Lifejackets and Lifebuoys for Fishermen
other_conditions: Applicant must be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession
Applicant must possess one of the following: a Canoe Fitted With OBM, Mechanised Trawlers Engaged in Trawling Operations, or Mechanised Trawlers Engaged in Purse Seining Operations
benefits_summary: Provides 50% financial assistance up to ₹1,000 per lifejacket and ₹1,500 per lifebuoy for eligible fishermen.
